lina (Docs): FYI I opened a docs PR to add a small installer troubleshooting section for onprem HSMs behind chained proxies: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/499. Needs language review and an SDK snippet for Java and Go client TLS pin check. cc @ryan @tess

omar (Eng-ML): Thanks. Main tech points: 1) PKCS#11 library path can change between distros; add example paths for ubuntu/debian/centos. 2) If you use a proxy chain that terminates TLS, HSM attestation fails. Recommend using TCP passthrough or SNI passthrough.

lina (Docs): I'm drafting an explicit callout: "Do not TLS-terminate the KMS/HSM channel in the proxy chain; use TCP or SNI passthrough so client certs remain intact." Is that too prescriptive?

ryan (Security): That's good. Add the exact failure log that appears on the device side so ops can search for it: `pkcs11: token does not recognize mechanism CKM_SHA256_RSA_PKCS` — that usually indicates cert negotiation was intercepted. Also include the client fingerprint example and command to verify during bootstrap: `openssl s_client -connect kms.internal:443 -servername kms.internal | openssl x509 -noout -fingerprint -sha256`

lina (Docs): Adding the log snippet. Also adding a tiny troubleshooting checklist: 1) verify proxy type (SNI vs terminate) 2) verify PKCS11 path 3) confirm port mapping in installer systemd unit 4) check outbound egress rule for KMS CIDR.

tess (Infra): One more: in air-gapped installs we often mirror rpms/images to a local registry. I added a brief note on verifying bundle checksums with sha256sum and where to fetch the signature: `/var/lib/redwood-offline/signatures/installer.sig`. Also suggested a script snippet to validate image tarballs before systemd starts.

lina (Docs): Nice. Can you paste the script snippet? I'll format it in a code block.

tess (Infra): Sure:
```bash
# verify installer bundle before unpack
sha256sum -c /var/lib/redwood-offline/signatures/installer.sha256 || { echo "bundle checksum mismatch"; exit 1; }
# verify signature (gpg key already provisioned)
gpg --verify /var/lib/redwood-offline/signatures/installer.sig /opt/redwood/installer.tar.gz || { echo "signature invalid"; exit 1; }
```

omar (Eng-ML): For SDK snippets: Java folks expect an example of pinning the KMS cert thumbprint at client startup. Go folks want a net.Dial workaround example when SNI passthrough isn't available. I can sketch both.

lina (Docs): Please do — keep them short. We don't need full libs, just a minimal example and a comment about production libs.

omar (Eng-ML): Java (okhttp example):
```java
// verify server cert fingerprint before using the client
String expected = "SHA256:BBBBBBBBBBBB...";
TrustManager tm = new FingerprintTrustManager(expected);
OkHttpClient client = new OkHttpClient.Builder().sslSocketFactory(sslContext.getSocketFactory(), tm).build();
```

// Go example (net.Dial + TLS handshake with ServerName):
```go
conn, err := net.Dial("tcp", "kms.internal:443")
if err != nil { log.Fatal(err) }
cfg := &tls.Config{ServerName: "kms.internal"}
client := tls.Client(conn, cfg)
if err := client.Handshake(); err != nil { log.Fatal(err) }
// inspect cert and compare fingerprint
```

ryan (Security): Good. Add a one-liner warning: "Do not accept insecureSkipVerify in production; always verify fingerprint or CA chain." Also add a pointer to the security playbook for key rotation steps.

lina (Docs): Done. One remaining docs item: two internal links in the PR were flagged by linkcheck — one to the installer systemd unit and one to the HSM FAQ. I updated the HSM FAQ link; the systemd unit is under eng-infra but path differs. Mike? (not in thread)

qa-bot: PR #499 opened by lina (Docs). Checks: markdown-lint OK, linkcheck: 2 warnings (HSM FAQ fixed) — remaining: `/eng-infra/units/installer.service` 404. Please update.

lina (Docs): I'll chase the path with eng-infra channel. For now I'll add a temporary note pointing to `/assets/units/installer.service.example` in the repo. Thanks everyone — should be ready for a short tech review and then we can merge.

ryan (Security): LGTM once the systemd link is fixed. Also request: add a single sentence about logging socket destinations (netstat/ss) during bootstrap for triage.

lina (Docs): Added. Will squash fixups before merge.
